verdict.rationale: Ramp documents multiple autonomous background workflows (auto-receipt capture, invoice matching/coding/routing, hotel rebooking, auto top-up with target balances) that run without manual user action, plus an official MCP server and CLI enabling AI-driven automation setup. However, these are presented as built-in product features rather than a general user-configurable 'automation builder' for arbitrary background tasks, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming reliability of these autonomous runs. Missing for 10: evidence of a flexible automation/workflow builder for arbitrary triggers, and independent verification that autonomous automations run reliably in production.
